chapter: The war years: Barnet, Hot Lips Page, Newton and Kirby
title: Playing with Lester Young in New York and Canada
summary: He toured Canada with Lester Young's group with Lee Young, Bumps Myers and bassist Jesus, and again with Kirby.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Well, let me see. I went to California with him. I went to Toronto with him. Before that, I was with Lester Young.
Every time we....you remember something...
Ramirez - 109
He was at the Hi-Hat, and with Lee Young drums, Bumps Myers...
That's on the West Coast.
On the East Coast here.
Really?

Toronto, yes, I played with him there. We toured Canada. The second time I toured Canada was with John Kirby. See, John Kirby would be near the end of that era, because the war was coming to a close. So it would be in '45... That's the time when "Lover Man" started coming out.
The thing is, did you go with Lester before Kirby?
I would say yes. I had a picture of it, and my wife just took it...and it's not... The only picture I have of Lester Young, Lee Young, all of us, Bumps Myers... together.
It's a shame you can't find that. But where did you join them? In California?
Right here. The name of the bass player was Jesus.
Jesus what?
Jesus. He came to the West End to see me.
Was he good?
He was a good bass player. Jesus. He loved
Ramirez - 110
on 110th Street. Leon, his brother, was a drummer. And Bumps Myers... They used to double up.
What would he have another tenor for? Why Bumps Myers? Why did Lester want two tenors?
Well, I don't know. I mean, it was the (?). Two tenors, you know.
They were doing like Basie.
Well, I guess so. We played all over. It was cool. I remember it. I didn't think it was important at the time. We had (?) people; I mean, I'm playing with these big names and all. I didn't...
It's a pity that this guy hasn't got more of the... Like Lips and Lester... I mean, there's a lot missing here.
Oh, that's nothing. You wait and see.
